subject: [PATCH RFC nfs-utils v2 02/10] nfsdctl: probe the policy of any command

2026-09-14.patch_summary: This patch modifies the nfsdctl utility to probe the policy of any command, not just THREADS_SET. It introduces a new function query_nfsd_nl_cmd_policy() that takes the command number as an argument and writes the highest attribute through its callback argument. The existing query_nfsd_nl_policy() function is updated to call this new function with the THREADS_SET command number. This change allows multiple commands to use the getpolicy_handler() function simultaneously, without overwriting each other's results.
